newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Telebras 1996 results seen out this week.
newsitem.headline: Telebras 1996 results seen out this week.

text.p: Brazilian state-owned telecommunications firm Telebras is likely to release 1996 full-year results this week, said Telebras president Fernando Xavier Ferreira.
"There is a strong possibility of the results being released this week," Ferreira told reporters.
He also said Telebras' 1996 results are unlikely to be very different from the figures recently revealed by Communications Minister Sergio Motta.
Earlier this month Motta said Telebras posted a 3.2 billion reais profit in 1996, without specifying if this was net or gross earnings.
Ferreira gave no more details on the forthcoming Telebras results.
In the first 11 months of 1996, Telebras' net consolidated profit totalled 2.4 billion reais, Ferreira said. In the entire year of 1995, Telebras posted a 810 million reais profit.
Ferreira said an increase in traffic, a reduction in costs and a tariff rebalancing late November 1995 influenced Telebras' 1996 results.
Ferreira was in Sao Paulo to speak at a seminar on private savings.
Telebras stock accounts for 70 percent on average of trade on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa).
